name: source_type
description: Historical combined source vocabulary. Human channels now belong to Decision.source_channel, producing machine kinds to Assessment.kind. Rebaseline and restatement remain administrative operations, not evidence kinds. Source type never supplies a missing evidence grade.

definitions.mr_comment: A human judgement submitted in a merge or pull request comment.
definitions.commit: A human judgement associated with a commit.
definitions.jira: A human judgement submitted through Jira.
definitions.rebaseline: An administrative finding rename; not an evidence or validity assertion.
definitions.restatement: An administrative data correction; not an evidence kind.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.

rebaseline.note: Administrative rename operation; no judgement or evidence kind is implied.

restatement.note: The decision owner handles restatement; no evidence kind is implied.
